response.sql: SELECT SUM(g - l) as total_games_minus_losses, COUNT(*) as record_count FROM manager_half WHERE w > 26 AND g IS NOT NULL AND l IS NOT NULL

assumptions.assumption: "Pass the 26-win mark" means w > 26 (strictly greater than). An alternative reading could be w >= 26 (meet or exceed).

alternatives.interpretation: If "pass the 26-win mark" means w >= 26 instead of strictly greater than 26
